description: This file defines Kubernetes policy API types related to PodDisruptionBudget and Eviction, including their specifications, status, and related constants.

classes.name: PodDisruptionBudgetSpec
classes.description: Specifies the desired state of a PodDisruptionBudget, including minAvailable, maxUnavailable, selector, and unhealthy pod eviction policy.

classes.name: PodDisruptionBudgetStatus
classes.description: Represents the current status of a PodDisruptionBudget, including disruption counts, conditions, and observed generation.

classes.name: PodDisruptionBudget
classes.description: Defines a PodDisruptionBudget object with metadata, spec, and status.

classes.name: Eviction
classes.description: Represents a pod eviction request, including metadata and optional delete options.
